description: Lodge a booking. On success this returns a secure checkout_url: give it to the customer to pay directly (their card, never through you). No payment is ever taken through this tool itself. A pickup on a closed day or inside a blackout window is refused (accepted:false) before anything is lodged. Requires agent_key (contact admin@cgctransfers.com.au to obtain one).

child_seats.description: Child seats required ($35 each, supplied and fitted). Prefer seat_qty, which prices the seats into the booking and pay link.

luggage.description: Optional. Large suitcases. If left out, assumed to be what the chosen vehicle holds (never more than one per passenger).

meet_greet.description: Optional. Add the Brisbane Airport in-terminal meet and greet ($49). Gold Coast Airport pickups include it already.

oversized.description: Optional. Surfboard, golf bag, bike box, full-size pram or similar (takes the space of three large bags, so sedans drop out).

platform.description: Which channel this booking comes from (attribution)

return_date.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. With return_time, books the return leg on the same reservation (5% return discount applies).

return_dropoff.description: Optional, only with return_date and return_time: where the return trip drops off, if not the first trip's pickup. Defaults to the first trip reversed.

return_pickup.description: Optional, only with return_date and return_time: where the return trip picks up, if not the first trip's drop-off (in to one hotel, back from another). Defaults to the first trip reversed. With different return addresses each trip is priced at its own fare and the return discount comes off the cheaper trip, as on the booking form; use the same return_pickup and return_dropoff as the get_quote you quoted.

return_time.description: Optional, HH:MM 24h, in 5-minute steps. Required if return_date is given.

seat_qty.description: Child seats by type, priced into the booking and pay link ($35 each): {seat index: quantity}. Indices follow the booking form list: 0 rear-facing 0-3yrs, 1 forward-facing 6mths-3yrs, 2 harnessed booster 3-6yrs, 3 booster with adult seatbelt 6yrs+.

terms_accepted.description: REQUIRED, must be true. Confirms the customer has been shown and has accepted the booking terms at https://cgctransfers.com.au/bookingtermsandconditions/ -- do not set this without an explicit yes from the customer.

vehicle.description: Vehicle choice; defaults to sedan. crafter = VW Crafter (up to 11 passengers), one van for a group too big for one Carnival; crafter-trailer = the same van towing a luggage trailer, for a big group with more luggage than the van takes (get_quote with pax gives the live seat, child-seat and luggage limits). Any other value is refused (accepted:false, "Unknown vehicle"), never booked as a different vehicle.
